questions.question: Analyse toxic relationship affect an individual sense of self-worth and confidence? Explain.
questions.solution_html:
• A toxic relationship damages an individual’s self-worth through constant
  • criticism, control, and emotional neglect. It creates insecurity, fear, and
  • reduced confidence. Over time, the person may internalize negativity and
  • lose emotional stability.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: lose emotional stability.

questions.question: Discuss the role of self-disclosure in building intimacy and trust in relationships.
questions.solution_html:

  • experiences with others. It strengthens emotional bonding and deepens
  • interpersonal trust. Through honest communication, intimacy grows and
  • relationships become more meaningful.
